scope: Current source reinspection and drift guard only; historical findings remain historical, not claims of current Rust rejection. No Rust production source was modified. Initial PC/clock constants are also in setup source coverage.

full_statement_verifier/src/unrolled_pro.observation: Reads final PC/timestamps as u32 words, absorbs them and compares accumulated products after initial/final endpoint contributions. This is canonical endpoint source evidence, not exact logical matching or cryptographic/Rust refinement.

full_statement_verifier/src/unified_circ.observation: Unified path reads/absorbs final u32 PC/timestamps and compares global products after shared initial/final endpoint contributions. Cryptographic and logical-matching boundaries remain external.

prover/src/definitions/mod.rs.observation: Mask/shift splits u32 PC into canonical u16 limbs, with distinct PC low/high coefficients in PC address space. Timestamp limbs use field reduction. Initial is written and final is read.

cs/src/definitions/constants.rs.observation: PC low/high challenges alias memory-value indices4/5; timestamp indices2/3 remain separate. Unchanged from cited historical inspection.

cs/src/gkr_compiler/memory_like_grand_pr.observation: PC start/end tuples retain separate U16Limbs and timestamps in PC space. Final read/write products each have an enforced MaskIntoIdentityProduct using copied native execute.

cs/src/gkr_compiler/family_circuit.rs.observation: Native execute gates the decoder lookup and feeds raw PC/clock plus architectural RAM sets into the memory grand-product compiler. Copied execute gates final products; sampled-product equality is not deterministic tuple matching.

prover/src/gkr/sumcheck/evaluation_kerne.observation: Relation and evaluators implement (input-1)*mask+1. Boolean mask0 returns1, mask1 returns input. Unchanged from cited historical inspection.

verifier/src/generated/add_sub_lui_auipc.observation: Generated ADD/SUB verifier contains two MaskToIdentity gates sharing mask input0 and evaluates subtract1/multiply-mask/add1. This inspection does not assert all generated verifiers equivalent.
